cpos.reason: Official Sonnenstrom Saarpfalz material resolves the own-network Charge Flex contract exactly as a dynamic tariff: 34.900 ct/kWh base price plus the EPEX SPOT Day-Ahead component applicable at session start; the spot component changes every 15 minutes. The official page also specifies a DC post-charge blocking fee of 20.000 ct/min after 60 free minutes, capped at 12.00 EUR per session, and no AC blocking fee. Public station records tie DE*SSP EVSEs to Sonnenstrom Saarpfalz, including the Zweibruecken Energiepark. However, public ad-hoc/direct-payment station pages currently report the direct price as unknown, and a static per-kWh value would be incorrect because the contractual price is time-dependent. Keep this CPO partially treated until the live spot component can be reproduced at query/session-start time or a public ad-hoc QR payload exposes an exact station price.

resolvedContract.name: Charge Flex
resolvedContract.spotComponent: EPEX SPOT Day-Ahead; changes every 15 minutes; session uses spot price at charging start

cpos.unblockRequires: A reproducible public live feed for the current 15-minute spot component usable by TCC at session-start time, or a public DE*SSP QR/direct-payment payload exposing the exact ad-hoc price for a specific EVSE/station.
